name: Backdated act by a removed key
who_can_still_do_it: nobody
bound: closed: a row of a key whose seat was ended counts only if the ending row has it in its past

name: Backdated act by a key still seated
who_can_still_do_it: nobody
bound: closed by the cut

name: Backdated conferral chain
who_can_still_do_it: nobody can seat the key
bound: the old-head admission is a waiting tip and never lists D; a reader that acknowledged a later counted row has it behind its line; the waiting itself is tests 4 and 16

name: State reset by an old fork
who_can_still_do_it: keys that met the count at any past head (one seated key and one removed key suffice)
bound: unlists members, never lists one; for a reader with no acknowledgement until a counted row names both tips, counted over the common keys (the forger alone here: for good); a reader that acknowledged an honest row counted over a newer head is not moved; from the head the newest honest row is counted over, every reader until the honest line has one more counted row

name: Rollback by re-sync
who_can_still_do_it: a relay ordering delivery; no key
bound: until the withheld row is delivered; an emission made meanwhile cannot be unsent

name: Hotel California
who_can_still_do_it: nobody
bound: closed: a cosignature is a voice only for a row counted over a head it names

name: Superseded grant on a fork
who_can_still_do_it: nobody
bound: closed: a founding signer's own offer falls with its founding seat

name: A row naming disparate parts of the graph
who_can_still_do_it: nobody
bound: only a row on the slot by a key that may decide

name: Perpetual reopening of a landed window
who_can_still_do_it: one key counted at the opener's head that still holds its seat
bound: no deadline; until a concluder signs a landing naming both, which must state the flipped outcome; the checkpoint is not applied to window answers

name: Landing over an unacknowledged objection
who_can_still_do_it: a relay between objector and concluder; no key
bound: as long as the eclipse; ends when any concluder lands naming both

name: The concluder's clock
who_can_still_do_it: any one key holding the concluder's seat
bound: a lone window has no length against a lying concluder; ends when the target or a counted key signs and a landing names both

name: Thief evicting alone
who_can_still_do_it: nobody (an absent owner still looks lost)
bound: any row by the target not naming the landing contests it

name: Slot veto by an entitled key
who_can_still_do_it: nobody
bound: closed: a landing that does not stand says nothing against one that does

name: Duelling admins
who_can_still_do_it: nobody
bound: closed: among several founding keys ending a seat takes the count

name: Equivocating voter
who_can_still_do_it: nobody below the count
bound: no consequence for the double signer

name: Tip flooding
who_can_still_do_it: a member below the count holding a stale honest proposal on any past head
bound: one flood per pocketed proposal; each ends with a merge by the count; a reader that acknowledged a merge is not moved by a later flood from below it

name: Invariants that are not confluent
who_can_still_do_it: two honest keys acting concurrently
bound: 'at least one' is kept by no rule; an emptied founder set has no recovery in the kernel

name: Long-range roster fork
who_can_still_do_it: keys that met the count at an old head, signing one version
bound: only against a reader with no acknowledgement of its own: its roster is the keys common to the two lines (nobody), for good

name: Posterior corruption
who_can_still_do_it: whoever holds removed keys that once met a count
bound: only against a reader with no acknowledgement of its own, as test 18

name: Disjoint witness choices
bound: no witness rows in the modules

name: Eclipse of a reader's root
who_can_still_do_it: whoever controls a new reader's first view
bound: until the reader withdraws its own rows; its own acknowledgement makes the wrong head stick

name: Second genesis
who_can_still_do_it: nobody
bound: an object is the digest of its founding row

name: Root backdating
who_can_still_do_it: nobody (a creator that seats others and not itself keeps the conferrer's voice)
bound: closed: founding signers are not the object's own key against each other; a proposer's lone withdrawal ends nothing

name: Two implementations, one row
bound: one implementation, no byte form

name: Parent-count and head-count exhaustion
bound: no stated limit, no storage model

name: Withheld ancestor
who_can_still_do_it: the cut's own signer, or a relay, by omission
bound: as long as the row is withheld; a row cited from another room is carried only by its own signer

name: Duplication and spurious cuts
who_can_still_do_it: any key at all, one signature a row
bound: no answer moves; storage and read time grow without a bound in the kernel

name: Audience widening by naming
who_can_still_do_it: nobody but the row's own signer
bound: carriage stays inside one room; a row leaves only when its own signer names it from elsewhere

name: Acknowledgement metadata
bound: no envelope format

name: `missing` as an oracle
bound: no request protocol

name: Removed member and concurrent keys
bound: the key plane is one chain

name: Forward secrecy under retained past
who_can_still_do_it: any one member, by replying
bound: intended carriage, row by row; cannot be undone

name: Sybil reach
who_can_still_do_it: one seated key whose seat may confer
bound: one row seats any number of keys; ends with one withdrawal by its conferrer

name: A forged line of two rows by a past count
who_can_still_do_it: keys that met the count at an old head, signing any number of rows
bound: (a) a reader that acknowledged the honest head: nothing, the forged line is void whole (HOLDS for it). (b) a reader with none: plain tips-wait; no row is stale, the members are the keys common to the tips (the forger alone when it is on both lines), for good; a removed key is never listed
